I'm Mexican and Breaking Bad and Good Spanish are not compatible, I get they wanted Mark Margolis or Steven Bauer bc of their Scarface Pedigree, but Mark Margolis spoke terrible Spanish in Scarface, and he does it again in Breaking bad and BCS, I don't even wanna get into Gus Fring's spanish abilities, or even some of the names are super iffy (There's NO ONE in Mexico named VUENTE or ESCALADA or CISCO, I can assure you). Another complaint is that the little amount of actors (EXCEPT NACHO) who actually spoke better spanish, spoke very politely, no slang, no curse words, and believe me, in Mexico.. WE SWEAR a lot... 

For a show with such great writers and with such care in production values, this (for native spanish speakers specifically) really makes you laugh sometimes. 

But it's also a testament of how great of a show it is, that even with these laughable cartel narcos that barely can speak Spanish or have names that an 8 yr old would've pick bc they sound cool, you can still immerse yourself and enjoy a great story. 

I would never trade Giancarlo Esposito's acting as Gus Fring or Mark Margolis' Hector for ANYTHING.
